params.body:
A design and implementation plan, no code: `docs/verkennen-en-overdragen.md`.

## Why

Every handover page already works on the same nodes (relation, project, person, machine, material), each with one anchor and one panel (`NodeContext`). The confusion is in the interface around them:

- One thing has three names: the menu group is Overdracht, the page at `/overdracht` is Bespreken, and the group also holds Netwerk and Historiek, which browse rather than hand over.
- Bespreken does two jobs on one page: a list to work down (Te bespreken) and an archive with filters and a CSV.
- Netwerk and Bespreken let you set the same properties on a relation, and nothing shows that Belang decides what lands on the list.
- "Openen in Netwerk" leaves the list with no way back to where the table was.

## The proposal

Two modes on one model, switched by two words in the header:

- **Verkennen** (Netwerk, Historiek): free browsing. Adds two actions in the node panel: *Op de lijst zetten* (Belang Hoog, any node type) and *Nu bespreken* (opens that node in Overdragen).
- **Overdragen** (Volgende, Verteld, Medewerkers): one node at a time. Volgende shows where you are in the three steps, why this node is up, what is known, up to five neighbours, the existing context form, and the actions Volgende, Niets bijzonders, Later, and Bekijken in Verkennen (with Terug naar Overdragen). Verteld is the archive half of Bespreken; `/overdracht` redirects there.

No new storage for the modes. A small read model (`App\Graph\Node`, `App\Graph\Nodes`, `Agenda::next`) gathers what is now spread over `ContextNote::typeOf`, `HandoverNotes::link`, `Network::expand` and `Office\Explore`.

## Build plan

Five PRs, each with its tests listed in the document: (1) graph read model, no visible change; (2) mode switch and menu, Bespreken split; (3) the guided flow; (4) Verkennen actions and any node with Belang Hoog on the list; (5) cleanup. After 2 the menu confusion is gone; after 3 the table works with Volgende.

## Open questions

Four, at the end of the document: the words (Verkennen was Historiek's name until today), where machines marked Hoog go on the list, whether Later must be stored, and whether Netwerk and Historiek should become one page (proposed: not in this plan).

## Checks

Documentation only. The suite still passes: 332 tests.
params.title: Plan: Verkennen and Overdragen, two modes on one node model
